nse:106830108.question: What had management said on recent calls about revenue and margins for this period, and does this result match it?
nse:106830108.answer: In October 2025 (Q2 FY26 call), management projected approximately 5% revenue growth for the coming year and guided for average margins of 12% to 15%+. The Q2 FY27 results do not match this, as revenue declined 16.5% YoY to ₹2,446.1 crore and EBITDA margin fell to 8.1%.

evidence.quote: We anticipate that this year, we will have revenue of approximately INR 12,500 crores or so. And the coming year also, we should have may be another 5% growth over that
But on an average, we can anticipate around 15% plus margins
And in that case, we expect that the margins will be around 12% to 15%

nse:106818661.question: What had management said on recent calls about revenue and margins for this period, and does this result match it?
nse:106818661.answer: In June 2026 (Q1 FY27 call), management stated its $650 million deal would be "accretive - revenue & margin from Q2 onwards." In October 2026 (Q2 FY27 call), management cited an aspirational margin range of 16% to 17%. For Q2 FY27, revenue grew 30.3% YoY to ₹4,663.9 crore, while EBIT margin stood at 15%.

evidence.quote: And yes, it will be accretive - revenue & margin from Q2 onwards
Yeah, so from our perspective we have said we want to be in the 16 to 17 % range, that is our aspiration

nse:106829089.question: What had management said on recent calls about revenue and margins for this period, and does this result match it?
nse:106829089.answer: Management refrained from giving specific numerical revenue or margin guidance for Q2 FY27, stating in Q1 FY27 that they do not give guidance "at this point of time." However, they expected to consolidate Bluetile from Q2 FY27 and accelerate FY27 growth. The Q2 results align with this expansion, showing revenue up 52.6% YoY and EBITDA margin at 14.1%.

evidence.quote: And subject to the final closing, we are expecting to start consolidating this entire business from Q2 FY27
and we will continue to accelerate growth both in revenues and EBITDA in FY '27

nse:106823393.question: What had management said on recent calls about revenue and margins for this period, and does this result match it?
nse:106823393.answer: Management maintained a long-term guidance of a 6% Adjusted EBITDA margin for quick commerce in Q1 FY27, expecting margins to directionally improve. In Q2 FY27, management noted that food delivery margins would likely stay flattish over the next 1-2 years due to growth reinvestments. Q2 FY27 reported an overall EBITDA margin of 3.1%.

evidence.quote: we think at this point we're likely to end at the higher end of the range that we had guided earlier and hence, the communication
It's hard to project or comment on margin trajectory every quarter but broadly, over the next 1 or 2 years, we expect the margins to remain flattish
Directionally, we want to maintain margins broadly and reinvest in growth as much as it makes sense to continue to drive the growth upwards

nse:106810133.question: What has management said about debt, leverage and its credit profile?
nse:106810133.answer: In February 2026, management reported gross long-term debt of ~INR 78,000 crores (~$9B) and total external debt of ~INR 62,000 crores. In April 2026, CFO Robbie Singh stated that core infrastructure leverage would track between 3.5x to 4.5x, expecting overall leverage (then at 3.9x) to remain flat or decrease slightly in the next fiscal year.

evidence.quote: So ~INR 78,000 crores being the total debt, ~INR 16,000 crores being shareholder loans, giving us a total external debt of about ~INR 62,000 crores
don't expect that to change. So our core infra will track the core infra. So we guide to that in the core infra while we are growing, we will be closer to the 3.5 to 4.5 range.
So the 3.9x is likely to remain either flat or slightly down

nse:106805308.question: What has management said on recent calls about leadership, succession or this role?
nse:106805308.answer: Management welcomed Anup Bagchi as the new MD and CEO starting October 2026. Sashi Jagdishan expressed privilege in leading HDFC Bank as his tenure ends. Additionally, Kaizad Bharucha requested an early retirement effective December 2026. Management also appointed Rajiv Kumar as Chairman in July 2026 and announced plans for a new Whole-Time Director.

evidence.quote: I'm really grateful to the Board for the trust placed in me as MD and CEO

As my long innings at HDFC Bank come to an end, I would like to say that it has been an absolute privilege to lead this organization that brings together some of the most brilliant minds and over 200,000 extremely committed and focused professionals, a cutting-edge technology, a solid brand that binds the 100 million customers, and a collective zeal to consistently deliver top-class results for all our stakeholders
Yes. So, as we were in the call, I think the world would have just got another notification to the exchanges that our dear colleague, Kaizad, has requested for an early retirement by end of December

nse:106821168.question: What has management said on recent calls about leadership, succession or this role?
nse:106821168.answer: In October 2026 (Q2 FY27), MD Sashidhar Jagdishan announced the end of his leadership, welcoming new MD & CEO Anup Bagchi. Jagdishan also announced Deputy MD Kaizad Bharucha requested early retirement effective end-December 2026. Earlier in July 2026 (Q1 FY27), Jagdishan welcomed new Chairman Rajiv Kumar and noted ongoing board processes regarding Whole-Time Director appointments.

evidence.quote: I'm sure that the bank will keep scaling greater heights, which will be a matter of immense pride for all of us. I'll also leave behind in the hands of an able team spread across various levels in the organization throughout the country, led by a new and an able leader, and I welcome Anup at this juncture heartily to the institution as well
Thank you. Thank you, Sashi. Thank you, Srini. Thank you, Kaizad. I'm really grateful to the Board for the trust placed in me as MD and CEO
Yes. So, as we were in the call, I think the world would have just got another notification to the exchanges that our dear colleague, Kaizad, has requested for an early retirement by end of December

nse:106799352.question: Has management discussed this case or its possible financial impact on its calls?
nse:106799352.answer: Management did not discuss this on its last two calls.

nse:106831929.question: What had management said on recent calls about revenue and margins for this period, and does this result match it?
nse:106831929.answer: Management did not provide specific revenue or margin targets for Q2 FY27 on recent calls. They guided that Navi Mumbai Airport, Kutch Copper, and Ganga Expressway would add over ₹3,000 crore to FY27 EBITDA and noted short-term margin compression in solar module sales due to selling primarily in India.

evidence.quote: In the next fiscal year, AEL is set to unlock EBITDA from Navi Mumbai Airport, Kutch Copper and Ganga Expressway, which are expected to add over INR3,000 crores EBITDA to AEL

And the thing it does - it compresses the margin, but that gain we will make from productivity as we go through this. So short term there is slight margin compression, which you will notice in the numbers

nse:106830187.question: What had management said on recent calls about revenue and margins for this period, and does this result match it?
nse:106830187.answer: Management did not provide specific revenue or margin targets for Q2 FY27. On the Q4 FY26 call (April 2026), management stated it was difficult to give margin guidance due to input cost pressures and geopolitical uncertainties, though they expressed confidence in returning to a healthy margin trajectory once commodity and energy price headwinds subside.

evidence.quote: It will be difficult to put a number. But yes, in such a situation some cost headwinds do come and it's part of business
So it's always difficult to give out a guidance on margins
So we are very confident and optimistic that subject to these headwinds of the war, the commodities and the energy prices, after that is over, we'll come back to a healthy trajectory

nse:106829216.question: What had management said on recent calls about revenue and margins for this period, and does this result match it?
nse:106829216.answer: In May and July 2026 calls, management guided for accelerated revenue growth in FY27 and sequential increases in profitability beyond Q1's 8% EBITDA margin towards 15–20% in the medium term. The Q2 FY27 results match this, delivering 28.5% YoY revenue growth (₹2,648 crore) and an expanded EBITDA margin of 10.2%.

nse:106827323.question: What had management said on recent calls about revenue and margins for this period, and does this result match it?
nse:106827323.answer: In the Q4 FY26 call (April 2026), management declined to give specific numerical guidance for FY27 margins, noting war headwinds and commodity cost pressures. However, management expected FY27 volume growth of over 10% for Maruti Suzuki. The Q2 FY27 result delivered 26.0% YoY revenue growth, but EBITDA margins contracted to 8.9%.

evidence.quote: The broad expectation, which our Chairman also conveyed, is growth of over 10% this year as compared to the last year. And, of course, the situation is dynamic
So it's always difficult to give out a guidance on margins
So yes, there is some pressure, but we are taking it as part of regular business
